title: Combination gate in the circuit
statement: For any Boolean function $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\{0,1\}$ and natural numbers $k,p$, the gate at index $o_C(n,k)+p$ is the combination gate with bases $n+n$ and $n+o_F(n,k)$, parameter $n-k$, code given by $f$ and $k$, and index parameter $p$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on $n$ bits
